subject: Onsite demo (Stellar Systems) — coverage or reschedule
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stellarsys.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: carlos.mendes@stellarsys.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite demo week — confirm 2/16

Hi Rishi,

Quick heads up — we just had a last-minute change on our side. Our VP of Engineering (who was scheduled to lead the Q&A) got pulled into an extended on-site review with a supplier and will be traveling Feb 15–17.

We still want the demo and the team on site, but we need to know if you can either:
- Move the session to Feb 18 or 19, or
- Have someone from Redwood run the demo on Feb 16 in his place (we can handle Qs offline), or
- Record the session and share materials if neither works.

Apologies for the short notice — travel logistics changed late last night. Carlos and I are available for whichever option you prefer.

Attaching our updated site itinerary for reference.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Product Manager
Stellar Systems

Attachment: Stellar_Site_Itinerary.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stellarsys.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week — confirm 2/16

Thanks for the update, Lena — appreciate the flag.

We can definitely cover this in a couple of ways. My recommendation is to keep Feb 16 and have Lauren lead the live demo so you keep the momentum with your onsite attendees. Options:
- Lauren runs the live demo Feb 16 at the same time (we'll record and share the recording)
- Move to Feb 18/19 if you prefer the VP present (I can open up times)
- If you want a hybrid, we can run a shortened live demo on Feb 16 and schedule a deeper technical whiteboard with our engineers on Feb 19.

Lauren — are you able to take point for the live session on the 16th? If so I'll send an updated calendar invite and a quick runbook.

Tessa — can you attach the latest slide deck and the demo runbook to the new invite?

Lena/Carlos — which option do you prefer? If we go with Lauren covering, we'll confirm the headcount and whether you want any specific focus (inference latency, deployment modes, or security controls).

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-times.ics (calendar invite stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stellarsys.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 13:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week — confirm 2/16

Happy to cover the session on Feb 16. I can take the live demo and leave time at the end for the onsite team to raise any questions they want me to tag for a follow-up with your VP.

Requests from my side:
- Tessa, can you attach the latest demo deck and the runbook (I want the step-by-step for the cluster failover scenario)?
- Lena, please confirm approximate number of attendees and whether there are engineers who want a deeper look at the latency benchmarks so I can prep a short add-on.

I'll block Feb 16 at the current invite time in my calendar and prep a 40-minute demo + 20-minute Q&A. If we need a follow-up deep-dive, I can slot time on Feb 19 afternoon.

I'll attach a pared-down runbook for the on-site pace.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (application/pdf, 85KB)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stellarsys.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: carlos.mendes@stellarsys.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week — confirm 2/16

Perfect — thanks, Lauren and Rishi. Feb 16 with Lauren covering works well for us. We expect ~8 people in the room (product + two engineers) — they will focus on real-time inference and deployment options.

Please go ahead and send the updated invite and share the recording after. We'll follow up with a separate request if we want the VP in the deep-dive on Feb 19.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Lena
Senior Product Manager, Stellar Systems
